provenance_note: Declared demonstration covariance on the NF-BNCT-003 ideal absorber: 5% 1-sigma on the removal cross section (collapsed-data uncertainty), 3% on the boron kerma response (dosimetry-data uncertainty). Independent diagonal entries only; group-correlation blocks are exercised in the transport-crate unit tests.
qualification: Declared input for verification-method demonstration; not an evaluated nuclear-data covariance library.
